senses.gloss:
पुर् 1. पुर् (fr. rt. पॄ), only in inst. pl.
पूर्भिस्, Ved. in abundance, abundantly; (Sāy.) =
पूर्वकैः स्तवैः, with former praises.

पुर् 2. पुर् (probably an artificial rt.
invented to furnish an etymology for पुरस्
and पुरा below), cl. 6. P. पुरति, पुरितुम्, to
precede, go before, go at the head, lead.

पुर् 3. पुर्, ऊर्, f. (probably fr. rt. पॄ), a
rampart, wall; a stronghold, castle, fortress, fortified
city, town; the body (considered as the stronghold of
the पुरुष, q. v.); intellect (= महत्); N. of a
Daśa-rātra (Ved.).
—पुरञ्-जन, अस्, m. the living
principle, life, the soul (personified as a king); (ई), f.
understanding, intelligence (personified as the wife
of a king).
—पुरञ्-जय, अस्, m. ‘city-conqueror,’
N. of a hero on the side of the Kurus; of a son of
Sṛñjaya and father of Janam-ejaya; of a son of
Bhajamāna and Sṛñjarī; (= ककुत्-स्थ) N. of a
son of Śaśāda; = काकुत्स्थ; N. of a son of
Vindhya-śakti; of Medhāvin; of an elephant, the son
of Airāvaṇa.
—पुरन्-द, अस्, m. = पुरन्-दर.
—पुरन्-दर, अस्, m. ‘town-splitter’ or ‘fortress-
destroyer,’ an epithet of Indra (as breaking cities into
fragments with his thunderbolt?); the Indra of the
seventh Manv-antara; an epithet of Agni; of Śiva;
a thief, house-breaker; (आ), f. an epithet of Gaṅgā;
(अम्), n. a species of pepper, Piper Chaba.
—पु-
रन्दर-चाप, अस्, m. Indra's bow, the rainbow.
—पुरन्दर-पुरी, f., N. of a town in Mālava.
—पुरि-शय, अस्, आ, अम् (a word formed to explain
पुरुष), reposing in the fortress or fastness (i. e. the
body).
—पुरो-हन्, आ, घ्नी, अ (fr. पुरस्, acc. pl. of 3.
पुर् + हन्), Ved. breaking castles, destroying strong-
holds.
—पूर्-द्वार्, र्, f. or पूर्-द्वार, अम्, n. the
gate of a city.
—पूर्-पति, इस्, m., Ved. the lord of
a castle or city.
—पूर्-भिद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. breaking
down strongholds or castles.
—पूर्-भिद्य, अम्, n.,
Ved. the breaking of strongholds or castles; (Sāy.)
= सङ्ग्राम, war.
—पूर्-याण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
leading or conducting to the fastness (i. e. to the
celestial world).

पूर् पूर्, cl. 10. P. पूरयति, -यितुम्, more
properly regarded as a Caus. of rt. पॄ, q. v.

पुर-ग, अस्, आ, अम् (a corruption of पुरो-ग),
inclined or disposed towards, favourably inclined.
—पुरगा-वण, अस्, m., N. of a forest.

पुरतस्, ind. before (said both of place and
time), in front, in advance, in the presence of (with
gen.); पुरतः कृ, to place in front, cause to
precede, give the lead to.
पुरतस् पुरतस्. See rt. 2. पुर्, p. 582.

पुरन्-धि, इस्, f. (पुरम् connected with पुरस्
and पुरा, but by some considered to be fr. rt. पॄ),
Ved. understanding, intelligence, prudence, wisdom;
praise; (अयस्), f. pl. good thoughts or reflections;
(इस्, इस्, इ), intelligent, prudent, wise (said of Pūṣan,
Indra, a Ṛbhu, Bhaga, Savitṛ, Heaven and Earth;
perhaps also इस्, m., N. of a particular deity); (ac-
cording to Sāy.) = स्त्री-रूप or रूप-वत्.
—पु-
रन्धि-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. endowed with wisdom
or understanding.

पुरन्धि पुरन्-धि, पुरन्-ध्रि. See under
rt. 2. पुर्, p. 582, col. 2.

पुरन्-ध्रि, इस् or ई, f. an elderly married woman,
respectable matron; a woman whose husband and
children are living.

पुरस्, ind. before, in front, in advance, in the
presence of, before the eyes of (with gen., e. g.
तस्य पुरो वाचम् आददे, he commenced a speech
in his presence; or in the earlier language with the
abl. or loc., opposed to पश्चा, पश्चात्, पृष्ठे);
in the east, from the east, towards the east, east-
ward, (दक्षिणतः पुरः, towards the south-east);
[cf. पुरा, पुरतस्, पूर्व: Zend para, ‘before:’
Gr. πάρος, προ-πάοι-θεν, πρόσθε, πρόσθιος, perhaps
πρες in πρέσβυς: perhaps Lat. coram for poram,
palam for param: Goth. faura, ‘before;’ faur,
‘for:’ Old Germ. vora, ‘before;’ furi, ‘for:’ Old
Pruss. pirsdan, ‘before.’]
—पुर-उष्णिह्, क्, f.,
Ved., N. of a metre of three Pādas, the first con-
taining twelve, and the second and third eight
syllables each.
—पुर-एतृ, ता, m., Ved. one who
goes before, a guide, leader.
—पुरः-पाक, अस्,
आ, अम्, having fulfilment at hand, near fulfilment.
—पुरः-प्रस्रवण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. pouring
forth; (Sāy.) = पुरस्ताद् गच्छत्.
—पुरः-प्र-
हर्तृ, ता, m. one who fights in the front (of the
battle).
—पुरः-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, having fruit
night at hand, exhibiting fruit in advance, promising
fruit.
—पुरः-सद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. sitting in front,
presiding; sitting towards the east.
—पुरः-सर,
अस्, ई, अम्, going before or in advance; (अस्), m.
one who goes before, a forerunner, precursor, har-
binger, attendant; (at the end of comps. अस्, आ,
अम्), having as an attendant, attended by, preceded
by, connected with, with [cf. प्रियाख्यान-प्˚];
(अम्), ind. with, after.
—पुरः-स्थातृ, ता, त्री, तृ,
Ved. standing at the head, a leader.
—पुरः-
स्थायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, standing before one's eyes.
—पु-
रः-स्फुरत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, opening or be-
coming manifest before any one.
—पुरश्-चरण,
अस्, आ, अम्, making preparation; (अम्), n. a pre-
paratory or introductory rite, preparation; repetition
[]
of the name of a deity accompanied with burnt
offerings.
—पुरश्चरण-चन्द्रिका and पुरश्च-
रण-पद्धति-माला, f., N. of two works.
—पु-
रश्चरण-ता, f. the being engaged in making pre-
parations.
—पुरश्-छद, अस्, m. a species of grass,
Imperata Cylindrica (commonly called उलु); a nip-
ple.
—पुरस्-करण, अम्, n. the act of placing in
front, &c.; making perfect (?).
—पुरस्-करणीय
or पुरस्-कर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed in
front, to be set before; to be honoured, to be treated
with deference or respect; to be prepared or fitted
out; to be made complete.
—पुरस्-कार, अस्, m.
the placing before or in front; preference; showing
respect, treating with honour, distinction, deference;
worshipping; consecrating; causing to go before, ac-
companying, attending; preparing, making ready;
arranging, putting in array, making complete; attack-
ing, assailing; accusation; anticipating, expecting; (at
the end of a comp.) preceded or accompanied by,
joined or connected with, including.
—पुरस्-कार्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed in front or appointed, to be
charged or commissioned; to be prepared or fitted out,
&c.
—पुरस्-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to bring to the front, place before or in front,
station in front, cause to precede, hold before one's
self; to make one's leader; to lead; to place in office,
appoint; to show respect, pay respect, honour; to
set before one's self, keep in sight, have respect to,
make one's rule of conduct, attend to, regard, choose,
prefer; to show, evince, betray, manifest; to use
as a pretext.
—पुरस्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, placed
before or in front; advanced to the foremost rank,
placed in office, appointed; accompanied or attended
by, combined with, provided or furnished with, pos-
sessing; distinguished, honoured, respected; revered,
adored, worshipped; attended to, regarded, chosen,
adopted; made perfect, finished, polished; prepared;
sprinkled with holy water, anointed, initiated; con-
secrated; anticipated; accused, calumniated; harassed
or attacked by an enemy.
—पुरस्कृत-मध्यम-
क्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, taking or adopting a middle
course.
—पुरस्-कृत्य, ind. having placed before
or caused to precede; having appointed; having paid
respect to or honoured; having rewarded; having
attended to or regarded.
—पुरस्-क्रिया, f. a pre-
paratory or introductory rite; showing honour, de-
monstration of respect.
—पुरो-अग्नि, इस्, m., Ved.
the foremost fire or fire in front.
—पुरो-ऽक्षम्,
ind., Ved. before the axle-tree.
—पुरो-ग, अस्, आ,
अम्, going before, preceding, leading, a leader;
first, chief, principal, pre-eminent; (at the end of a
comp.) preceded by, accompanied by (e. g. देवा
अग्नि-पुरोगमाः, the gods preceded by Agni).
—पुरो-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, standing or being in
front of; preceded, gone before.
—पुरो-गति, इस्, इस्,
इ, preceding, going before; (इस्), m. a dog; (इस्), f.
precedence, going before.
—पुरो-गन्तृ, ता, m. a
messenger who goes before.
—पुरो-गम, अस्, आ,
अम्, going before or in front, travelling in front,
preceding, leading, a leader; first, most excellent;
best; (at the end of a comp.) preceded by, accom-
panied by.
—पुरो-गमन, अम्, n. going before,
preceding.
—पुरो-गव, अस्, ई, m. f., Ved. one who
precedes, a leader.
—पुरो-गा, आस्, m., Ved. going
before, a leader.
—पुरो-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going in
front or before, preceding, a leader, one who pre-
cedes; (ई), m. a dog.
—पुरो-गुरु, उस्, उस्, or वी, उ,
Ved. heavy before or in front.
—पुरोजन्म-ता, f.
priority of birth.
—पुरो-जन्मन्, आ, आ, अ, born
before.
—पुरो-जव, अस्, आ, अम्, excelling in speed,
swifter than; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Medhātithi
and of a Varṣa named after him; of a son of Prāṇa.
—पुरो-जिति, इस्, f., Ved. previous possession or ac-
quisition.
—पुरो-ज्योतिस्, इस्, इस्, इस्, Ved. preceded by
light.
—पुरो-डाश्, -डास् (or -ऌआस्), Ved. or पुरो-डाश,
अस्, m. a sacrificial cake of ground rice usually divided
into pieces and offered in one or more cups (कपाल);
an oblation of ghee or clarified butter with cakes of
ground meal; an oblation in general; a sort of flat
ladle or spoon used for placing the cakes in the
sacrificial fire; the orts or leavings of any substance
[]
used in an oblation to fire; Soma juice as drunk at
particular sacrifices; a Mantra or prayer recited in
offering oblations to fire.
—पुरोडाशिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
Ved. connected with the sacrificial cake.
—पुरो-
डाशीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the Puroḍāśa or
sacrificial cake, fit to be offered in oblations.
—पु-
रोडाश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, intended for the sacrificial cake,
fit for offering with ghee as an oblation to fire.
—पुरो-धस्, 2. पुरो-धा, पुरो-धातृ, पुरो-धा-
नीय, पुरोधिका, see under 1. पुरो-धा, col. 3.
—पुरोनुवाक्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having an
invitatory verse; [cf. the next.]
—पुरो-ऽनुवाक्या
(˚रस्-अन्˚), f., Ved., scil. ऋच्, an introductory or
invitatory verse.
—पुरो-भाग, अस्, m. the front
part, fore part; officiousness, meddling in other
people's affairs, obtrusiveness; malevolence; envy;
(अस्, आ, अम्), obtrusive, meddlesome.
—पुरोभागि-
ता, f. officiousness, obtrusiveness; malevolence.
—पुरो-भागिन्, ई, इनी, इ, taking the first share;
obtrusive, officious; malevolent, censorious, fault-
finding; envious, jealous.
—पुरो-भू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ,
Ved. being in front, excelling, superior (said of
Indra; according to Sāy. युद्धे पुरतः शत्रून्
अवाप्नोतीति पुरोभूः).
—पुरो-मारुत, अस्, m. a
wind blowing from before or in front, east wind
(opposed to पश्चान्-मारुत).
—पुरो-यावन्, आ,
अरी, अ, Ved. going in front, leading; (Sāy.) = पु-
रतो मिश्रयितृ, mingling foremost (in battles).
—पुरो-युध्, त्, त्, त्, or पुरो-योध, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. fighting before or in front.
—पुरो-रथ, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. one whose chariot is foremost; surpassing,
excelling, superior.
—पुरोरुङ्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. furnished with the Puro-ruc.
—पुरो-रुच्, क्, क्,
क्, Ved. shining before or in front of, shining in the
east; (क्), f., N. of certain Nivid formularies (or Padas)
recited at the morning sacrifice in the Ājya ceremony
before the principal hymn (सूक्त) or any part of it.
—पुरो-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being before the eyes or
in the presence of, being in front.
—पुरो-वसु, उस्,
उस्, उ, Ved. preceded by wealth (?); (perhaps a cor-
ruption of पुरू-वसु.)
—पुरो-वात, अस्, m. wind
from before, east wind.
—पुरो-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
being before, preceding.
—पुरो-हविस्, इस्, इस्, इस्,
Ved. previously provided with sacrifices or oblations.
—पुरो-हित, see under 1. पुरो-धा, col. 3.

पुरस् पुरस्, पुरस्तात्. See under rt. 2.
पुर्, p. 582, col. 2, and p. 583, col. 1.

पुरस्तात्, ind. before, in front of (with abl. or
gen.) in advance, towards the front, forward, at the
beginning or commencement, in the first place; ere;
previously, formerly, first; before the eyes of, in the
presence of; eastward, towards the east, in the east,
from the east [cf. उत्तर-प्˚]; in the preceding
part (of a book), further on, in the sequel.
—पु-
रस्ताज्-जप, अस्, m., Ved. a preceding Japa.
—पु-
रस्ताज्-ज्योतिस्, इस्, इस्, इस्, N. of a kind of Triṣṭubh,
the first Pāda of which contains eight syllables.
—पुरस्ताद्-उद्धार, अस्, m., Ved. a part given in
advance.
—पुरस्ताद्-धोम, अस्, m. (fr. पुरस्तात् +
होम), Ved. an introductory sacrifice.
—पुरस्ताद्-
धोम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having an introductory
sacrifice.
—पुरस्ताद्-बृहती, f., Ved. a kind of
Bṛhatī metre, the first Pāda or which contains twelve
syllables.
पुरस्तात्न, अस्, आ (?), अम्, preceding, going before.

पुरा, ind. (perhaps and old inst. sing. fr. a form
पुर for पर), in former times, formerly, of old,
in the olden time, in the days of old, of yore;
before, hitherto, up to the present time (with न,
‘never’); firstly, in the first place, first, at first (opposed
to पश्चा, पश्चात्); soon, ere long, shortly, in a
short time, by and by (in this sense giving a future
sense to the pres. by Pāṇ. III. 3, 4, e. g. पुरा
दूषयति स्थलीम्, ere long he will contaminate
the earth, Raghu-v. XII. 30; आलोके ते निपतति
पुरा, soon she will fall within [the range of] thy
sight, Megh. 84); before, ere (with abl. and in the
earlier language also with dat.); for the defence or
safety of (Ved.); securely from (Ved.); with the
exception of, except, besides (Ved.); [cf. पुरस्,
पूर्व; Gr. πάροι, πάροιθε, παροίτερος, πάλαι,
πάλαιος, perhaps πέλας, πλήσιος; Lat. por in por-
tendere; Goth. faura, faur; Angl. Sax. for,
[]
fora-, fore-.]
—पुरा-कथा, f. a story of the past,
an old legend.
—पुरा-कल्प, अस्, m. a former
creation, former age; a story or tale of the past.
—पुरा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, done formerly or of old,
done long ago; done or observed previously; begun,
commenced.
—पुरा-कृति, इस्, f. the former mode
of action.
—पुरा-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. former,
existing from of old or from aforetime (Sāy. =
पूर्व-जात, चिरन्तन).
—पुरा-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ,
of ancient origin or lineage; an epithet of kings.
—पुरा-वसु, उस्, m. an epithet of Bhīṣma.
—पुरा-विद्, त्, त्, त्, knowing the events of former
times, knowing or acquainted with the past; an
epithet of kings.
—पुरा-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, that
which has occurred or taken place in former times,
long since transpired; one who has lived in former
times; relating to ancient times, referring to times
of yore; (अम्), n. former conduct, former mode of
action; any old or legendary event; history, any
account of former events traditionary or heroic.
—पुरावृत्त-कथा, f. or पुरावृत्ताख्यान
(˚त-आख्˚), अम्, n. an old story or legend, a story
of the past.
—पुरावृत्ताख्यान-कथन (˚त-
आख्˚), अम्, n. telling old stories, relating tales of
the past.
—पुरा-साह्, षाट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. superior from
ancient times; (Sāy.) = पुराणाम् अभिभवितृ,
conqueror of cities.
—पुरोद्भव (˚रा-उद्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, of former or prior origin; (आ), f. a species of
plant, a drug (= महा-मेदा).
—पुरोपनीत (˚रा-
उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, formerly obtained or possessed.
पुरा पुरा. See p. 583, col. 1.

पुर, अम्, n. a fortress, castle, fortified town; a
town, city, a place containing large buildings surrounded
by a ditch and extending not less than one Kos in
length (if it extends for half that distance it is called
a खेट, if less than that, a कर्वट or small
market town; any smaller cluster of houses is called
[]
a ग्राम or village); ‘the city’ κατ’ ἐξοχήν, i. e.
Pāṭali-putra or Patna; a house, dwelling, abode,
residence; an upper story; the female apartments,
gynæceum; a store-house, repository; a brothel;
the body; the skin; the calyx of a flower or any
receptacle or cup formed of leaves; a fragrant grass,
a species of Cyperus (= नागर-मुस्ता); a kind of
resin, bdellium; N. of a constellation; N. of the
subdivisions of the Vedānta work called Tri-puṭī
or Tri-purī; (अस्), m. a kind of resin, bdellium;
yellow Barleria; N. of a demon; N. of a man;
(आ), f. a stronghold, castle (at the end of a comp.;
cf. जीव-प्˚, देव-प्˚); a kind of perfume; the east;
(ई), f. a fort, stronghold, castle; a town, city; the
body; [cf. Gr. πόλι-ς, πολί-χ-νη, πολί-χ-νιο-ν,
πολί-τη-ς, πτολί-ε-θρο-ν, perhaps also πύργος;]; per-
haps Lat. urbs; perhaps Lith. pil-ī-s, ‘a castle.’]
—पुर-कोट्ट, अम्, n. ‘city-stronghold,’ a citadel.
—पुर-जित्, त्, m. ‘conqueror of fortresses or conqueror
of Pura,’ an epithet of Śiva; N. of a prince (a son
of Aja and father of Ariṣṭa-nemi).
—पुर-ज्योतिस्,
इस्, n. an epithet of the region or world of Agni;
[cf. पुरो-ज्योतिस्.]
—पुर-तटी, f. a small market-
town, village; a small fair.
—पुर-तोरण, अम्, n.
‘city-arch,’ the outer gate of a city.
—पुर-देवता,
f. ‘city-deity,’ the tutelary deity of a town.
—पुर-
द्वार, अम्, n. a city-gate.
—पुर-द्विष्, ट्, m.

पुराण, अस्, आ, or ई, अम् (opposed to नूतन,
नव), belonging to ancient or olden times, ancient,

ancient history legendary and traditionary, legend
(= Gr. λόγος, μῦθος); the N. given to certain well-
known sacred works, supposed to have been com-
piled by the poet Vyāsa, and comprising the whole
body of modern Hindū mythology (each of which
should treat of five topics; cf. पञ्च-लक्षण.
There are eighteen acknowledged Purāṇas, usually
reckoned as follow: 1. Kūrma-p˚; 2. Garuḍa-p˚;
3. Vṛhan-nāradīya-p˚; 4. Padma-p˚; 5. Brahma-p˚;
6. Brahma-vaivarta-p˚, which is of very modern
origin; 7. Brahmāṇḍa-p˚; 8. Bhaviṣya-p˚; 9. Bhā-
gavata-p˚, or the life of Kṛṣṇa, by some considered
a modern work; 10. Matsya-p˚; 11. Mārkaṇḍeya-p˚;
12. Liṅga-p˚; 13. Vāmana-p˚; 14. Vāyu-p˚, which is
probably one of the oldest; 15. Vārāha-p˚; 16. Viṣṇu-
p˚; 17. Śiva-p˚; 18. Skanda-p˚. Some authorities sub-
stitute the Agni-p˚ for the Vāyu-p˚; and others add
the Narasiṃha-p˚, which is considered by some as an
Upa-p˚, q. v.; by some the Purāṇas are divided into
four or by others into six Saṃhitās or collections);
(अस्), m. a Karṣa or measure of silver (= 16 Paṇas
of cowries); N. of a Ṛṣi.

former creation; a story or tale of former time; [cf.
